title: 3 space facts that sound fake

scenes.say: Three space facts that sound *fake*, but are completely true.
On Venus, one *day* lasts longer than a whole *year*. It spins once every 243 Earth days, but circles the Sun in just 225.
scenes.headline: A day > a *year*

scenes.say: A single teaspoon of neutron star would weigh about a *billion tons*. Its matter is crushed so tightly that atoms collapse into neutrons.
scenes.headline: The *heaviest* teaspoon
scenes.label: 1 teaspoon = *1 billion tons*

scenes.say: And the sunlight hitting you right now left the Sun about *8 minutes* ago. So you always see the Sun as it was in the past.
scenes.headline: You see the *past*
scenes.label: for sunlight to *reach Earth*
scenes.note: the Sun you see is 8 minutes old

scenes.say: Follow BrainSnck for a new brain snack every day.

caption:
Space is stranger than fiction 🪐

1. A day on Venus (about 243 Earth days) is longer than its year (about 225 Earth days).
2. A teaspoon of neutron star would weigh around a billion tons.
3. Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth, so you always see the Sun as it was a few minutes ago.
